name: positron-nonmem
description: NONMEM as a first-class Positron language runtime: local nmfe76 execution (or via Positron Remote SSH), run history tree, and pharmacometric workbench features. Companion to the vscode-nmtran language extension.

commands.title: Positron NONMEM: Show NMTRAN Parsed Model (Debug)
Positron NONMEM: Promote Estimates to New Model
Positron NONMEM: End Current EM Mode (next.sig)

nonmem.shrinkageWarnPct.description: Shrinkage above this percent is highlighted red in the Fit Inspector (default: 30, the pharmacometrics convention). Set to 100 to effectively disable the warning.

nonmem.shrinkageBorderlineWarnPct.description: Shrinkage above this percent (but below `shrinkageWarnPct`) is highlighted yellow (warn — borderline) in the Fit Inspector. Default: 20. Set ≥ shrinkageWarnPct to disable the warn tier.

nonmem.rseThetaWarnPct.description: THETA RSE% above this is highlighted orange (warn). Above `rseWarnPct` (default 100) it's red instead. Default: 30, the common pharmacometric guideline.

nonmem.rseOmegaWarnPct.description: OMEGA / SIGMA RSE% above this is highlighted orange (warn). Above `rseWarnPct` (default 100) it's red. Random-effect RSEs are inherently larger than fixed-effect — default 50 reflects that.

nonmem.rseWarnPct.description: RSE% above this is highlighted red in the Fit Inspector (default: 100 — RSE ≥ |estimate| means the parameter is effectively unidentified).

nonmem.pValWarnThreshold.description: ETABAR P-value below this is highlighted orange (warn — borderline departure of ETABAR from zero). Below `pValBadThreshold` (default 0.05) it's red. Default: 0.1.

nonmem.pValBadThreshold.description: ETABAR P-value below this is highlighted red (significant — model mis-specification or omitted covariate suspect). Default: 0.05.

nonmem.corrRedFlagThreshold.description: Pairwise parameter correlation |r| above this is highlighted RED (bad tier) in the Fit Inspector's diagnostics red-flag list. Default 0.95 (textbook near-redundancy convention).

nonmem.corrWarnThreshold.description: Pairwise parameter correlation |r| above this (and below `corrRedFlagThreshold`) is highlighted YELLOW (warn tier) in the Fit Inspector's diagnostics red-flag list. Default 0.9. Set ≥ corrRedFlagThreshold to disable the warn tier.

nonmem.condNumberBadThreshold.description: COR-matrix condition number above this is highlighted RED (bad tier — strongly ill-conditioned; suspect overparameterization). Default 1000 (pharmacometrics convention; matches sumo / Pirana).

nonmem.condNumberWarnThreshold.description: COR-matrix condition number above this (and below `condNumberBadThreshold`) is highlighted ORANGE (warn tier — ill-conditioned; check for highly-correlated parameters). Default 100. Set ≥ condNumberBadThreshold to disable the warn tier.

nonmem.lineages.description: Named sub-lineages — each entry maps a lineage name to its list of `.mod` absolute paths (the curated set of runs that appear when that lineage is selected in the panel). Edited via right-click → Add to lineage… in the Run Lineage panel; manual edits also work. The path-based parent overrides in `lineageOverrides` apply across all lineages.

nonmem.lineageOfvThreshold.description: ΔOFV significance threshold for the Run Lineage view edge colours. Default 3.84 (χ²₁,0.05 — Keizer 2013 convention). Set higher for a stricter "improvement" definition (6.63 = χ²₁,0.01).

nonmem.lineageOverrides.description: Workspace-side parent overrides for the Run Lineage view. Map of child .mod absolute path → parent .mod absolute path (or null to force the child to be a root regardless of any `;; Based on:` marker in the file). Set via right-click → Set parent… in the Run Lineage panel; manual edits also work. Lets you wire ANY two runs together, not just `run<NNN>` named ones.
